description: This is a shell script for testing Git rebase operations involving changing file encodings and internationalization (i18n). It sets up test environments, performs merges and rebases with different encodings, and verifies the correctness of these operations.

methods.name: compare_msg
methods.description: Compares the content of a file against an expected conversion using specified iconv encodings.

methods.name: test_rebase_continue_update_encode
methods.description: Performs a rebase continuation after manually resolving conflicts and changing encoding settings, then verifies the result.
